why: Negative Divergence: Price makes higher high while RSI makes lower low (bearish reversal signal)
If Daily RSI closes and sustains below 40 without reversal = signal failure
If Daily RSI closes and sustains above 60 without reversal = signal failure
Why: Closes gap on positive/negative divergence entry rules
